ARA Marine, formed in 2021 and part of the ARA Group, provides speciality marine safety services technical support and engineering solutions to the commercial shipping, yacht, and offshore maritime industry in 16 major Australian ports. An employee-owned company established in 2001, ARA is comprised of the following operating divisions:

1. ARA Fire & Security 
2. ARA Electrical
3. ARA Property Services
4. ARA Products
5. ARA Marine

We provide customers with a complete range of safety and certified services and requirements. Each company’s products, services, skills and experience complement the other’s to provide clients with the timely service that is required when a ship is in port for only 24 hours

ARA Marine is seeking a talented and experienced Mechanical Engineering Technician to join their team to help support growth. 

Location: 42 Zedora Turn, Henderson, WA 6166
Full time: 38 hours per week
Salary: $95,000 per annum + Superannuation

Key Responsibilities will include:
- Prepare mechanical engineering drawings plan and technical designs under the guidance of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
- Assist in the design and development and modification of mechanical equipment and machinery
- Select appropriate tools equipment, and materials for engineering projects and maintenance activities 
- Assemble, install, test and modify mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools, control systems, and hydraulic equipment 
- Estimate material quantities, project costs, and machinery requirements to support project planning and execution
- Conduct and oversee field and laboratory testing to evaluate equipment performance and compliance
- Ensure designs, installations, and completed work comply with engineering specifications, relevant standards, regulations, and contractual requirements
- Support engineering teams by providing technical expertise throughout the design, installation, testing, and maintenance phases of projects. 

Required skills and attributes:
- Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles and practices
- Ability to read, interpret, and prepare technical drawings, plans and schematics 
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality 
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
- Min 1 year of experience in a related field
- Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field  

If you meet the above criteria and you're interested in contributing to an organisation that values the highest level of quality in everything it sets out to achieve, we want to hear from you!

Apply now for this exciting opportunity to be part of the team at ARA Marine!

Job Type: Full-time
Work Location: In person

Payroll Officer – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for managing payroll processing activities, maintaining accurate employee records, and ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time. You will work closely with the finance, human resources, project, and operational teams to ensure payroll processes comply with company policies, awards, employment conditions, and relevant legislation.

Key Responsibilities
•	Process end-to-end payroll activities for employees, including weekly and fortnightly payroll cycles.
•	Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including salaries, allowances, deductions, leave balances, and employment details.
•	Verify timesheets, overtime, allowances, leave applications, and payroll adjustments.
•	Ensure payroll calculations comply with relevant awards, enterprise agreements, employment contracts, and legislation.
•	Process new employee onboarding, payroll setup, and employee changes.
•	Manage employee queries relating to payroll, leave entitlements, deductions, and payments.
•	Prepare payroll reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for management and finance teams.
•	Process superannuation payments, payroll tax, PAYG withholding, and other statutory obligations.
•	Maintain accurate records and assist with payroll audits and compliance reviews.
•	Liaise with HR, project managers, supervisors, and employees regarding payroll-related matters.
•	Assist with improving payroll processes and maintaining payroll system accuracy.
•	Ensure confidentiality and security of employee payroll information.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Payroll Officer or in a similar payroll/finance administration role.
•	Experience processing payroll in a medium to large organisation is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of payroll processes, employment conditions, and statutory requirements.
•	Experience with payroll software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
•	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial and employee data.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
•	Ability to manage confidential information professionally.
•	Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with employees and management teams.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $90,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work within a growing mining and industrial services organisation.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.
result.title: Payroll Officer

Expansion in 2012 saw the addition of a farm nestled amongst the rolling hills of the Strathbogie Ranges. An abundant fresh water natural spring carries life and nourishment to our free-range hens, where our farm began free range egg production in 2013.

We are seeking highly skilled and highly efficient Maintenance Engineer to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Work to verbal and/or written instructions provided by General Manager and Technical Manager
Ensure the efficient functioning of the Sanovo Grader Pro

Regular scheduled maintenance programs to cover a wide range of Sanovo equipment, including all other equipment and building used in grading operation

Analyse operational/technical problems. Determine and report on appropriate courses of action
Ensures the implementation of Valley Park Farm Quality Policy and quality system.
Respond to and resolve emergency breakdown and repair requirements.
Perform preventative, general and emergency maintenance requirements.
Maintain inventory of supplies, tools, equipment or material to ensure that sufficient resources are available, and items are in usable condition
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures.
Ensures the safe disposal of waste materials in compliance with regulations
Ensures strict compliance with the principles of quarantine, and bio security in all Valley Park Farm operations.

Strong mechanical knowledge on a wide variety of equipment
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer trade qualification or equivalent
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
